rows.grounds: compound pañcāśat-hasta-paryanta; extent up to fifty cubits
reiterates the upper boundary of the measure
qualifies the measure as valid for all regions

items.question: Up to what limit is a shrine measurement considered universally applicable?
premises: A universal shrine requires a prescribed measurement.
The prescribed extent reaches up to fifty cubits.
A measure within this extent qualifies as universally applicable.
items.inference: Therefore a shrine measurement up to fifty cubits is universally applicable.
uncertainties: The repetition of paryantaṃ after pañcāśaddhastaparyantaṃ may be emphatic or textual.
items.plain_english: The measure for a universal shrine may extend up to a limit of fifty cubits.
